criteria.evidence: OSM way 301841253 has addr:housenumber=607; the official chapter page lists 607 N University; Purdue Agriculture identifies Alpha Gamma Rho and provides a chapter-house image; shell polygon has 20 source vertices, 687.06 m² area, and OSM-aligned bounds.
criteria.finding: Identity and plan trace are strongly cross-checked, but the polygon is a community-mapped 2022 trace and is not an official measured survey.

criteria.evidence: The raw ring maps to 25.036 m E-W by 36.821 m N-S; the shell geometry is built from that same ring in the documented project conversion, with north-south long axis and east-facing address frontage.
criteria.finding: No independent Purdue GIS feature for 607 or survey control was returned; the GIS address query is empty. Campus-world horizontal registration beyond the OSM transform remains unverified.

criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: KJG Architecture describes the Purdue project as four levels and approximately 24,100 sq ft; its saved project render depicts a dark pitched roof, dormers, and brick/portico composition, corroborated by Purdue Agriculture photograph.
criteria.finding: The model uses a 10.35 m wall top and 13.8 m ridge by estimate. The source says four levels but does not clarify which are above grade; roof heights and exact roof geometry are not measured.

criteria.evidence: Purdue Agriculture photo and KJG project image directly show red brick, blue shutters/fascia, white columned portico, arched transom, and green ΑΓΡ pediment lettering. Exterior hero includes those features and four dormers.
criteria.finding: The modeled gable/roof and entrance proportions are stylized and the roof reads as a broad, simplified plane; no elevation drawing was supplied for exact bay spacing or proportions.

criteria.evidence: Saved asset reopens with scene and collection names intact; 726 collection objects and 725 meshes evaluate; no external file images; exterior/interior renders and source snapshots are present.
criteria.finding: Manifest path/collection are preserved, but shared manifest still reports the old one-object count while the exported collection is now detailed multi-object geometry; coordinator review is needed.

findings: Current identity/address match is strong despite no direct OSM name tag.
Footprint match is exact by construction and dimensions; position is only as trustworthy as the community mapping and local conversion.
Vertical dimensions and interior room layout remain estimates.
The manifest object-count field is stale and needs a coordinator update during integration.
